start.text: You came to visit, sweetheart. I'm so happy. Come in, let me make you some tea.

choices.text: Thanks, Mom. It's good to see you.
I need to talk to you about something.

warm.text: You've grown so much. Sometimes I look at you and still see that little boy. But you're a man now. A handsome one.

choices.text: Thanks, Mom. You look great too.

tease.text: A mother can't compliment her son? I remember when you used to crawl into my bed during thunderstorms.

choices.text: That was a long time ago.

compliment.text: Oh, you charmer. You get that from your father. Well... some of it.

choices.text: I'll take that as a compliment.

father.text: Your father was... complicated. He left when you were young. I had to raise you alone. It made me strong. And lonely.

choices.text: I'm sorry, Mom. You did great.

lonely.text: Sometimes. But I've learned to find comfort in other ways. This house is big. And quiet. Too quiet.

offer.text: I'd like that. You're always welcome here. Day or night.

choices.text: I'll come by more. I promise.
Maybe I could stay over sometime.

dating.text: Dating at my age? The men my age are boring. Younger men... now they're interesting. But that would be inappropriate.

inappropriate.text: Because... the only younger man I find interesting is my own son. And that's a line I shouldn't cross.

choices.text: Mom... are you saying what I think you're saying?
That IS inappropriate. Let's not go there.

confession.text: I'm saying I've thought about it. More than I should. You're a grown man. And I'm... lonely. And you're beautiful.

choices.text: Mom, that's... I don't know what to say.

uncertain.text: You don't have to say anything. I just needed to tell someone. Even if it's you.

choices.text: I'm glad you told me. Let's take it slow.

mutual.text: You have? Oh... oh my. Come here. Let me look at you properly.

intimate.text: You're so handsome. Just like I imagined. Let me... take care of you. The way I should have all those years.

slow.text: Of course. Take your time. I'll be here. I've waited this long.

shut_down.text: You're right. I'm sorry. I shouldn't have said anything. Please forget it.

choices.text: I won't tell anyone. And I'm not disgusted.

memory.text: Those were special nights. Just you and me. Safe and warm. I miss that simplicity.

choices.text: We can still have that. I'm here now.

warm2.text: You always know what to say. Come, sit with me. Tell me about your life. I want to know everything.

serious.text: What is it, sweetheart? You can tell me anything.

casual.text: Well, I'm glad you stopped by. Even if just passing. The door is always open.

choices.text: Maybe I'll stay for a while.

stay.text: I'd love that. The guest room is always ready. Or... you could stay in my room. If you want.
